ShortDescription.Value: Stops the crash to desktop after adding or removing port / oil rig sub-buildings, and logs what caused it.

Publish.LongDescription:
Does your game close without an error a few seconds to a minute after you add or remove sub-buildings on a port or an offshore oil rig? This mod stops that crash.
**What causes the crash** When sub-buildings are added or removed, some of their decoration props (mostly wall lights, ladders and AC units) can briefly keep pointing at a sub-building that has already been removed. The game's SubObjectReferencesSystem then tries to update that removed building and the game crashes (with Burst disabled you would see a NullReferenceException in UpdateSubObjectReferencesJob).
**What this mod does** - Watches only objects that are being created, changed or deleted, so it costs practically nothing. - When it finds an object whose owner no longer exists, it detaches that broken reference before the game's job reaches it, so the job skips it instead of crashing. - After a city loads it does a one-time, read-only scan and reports any such objects already in the save. - Writes what it found to Logs/OwnerCheck.log (summary by default, per-object details with "Verbose log").
**Options** (Options > OwnerCheck) - Crash guard: on by default. Turn off to only log. - Verbose log: one line per affected object, useful for bug reports.
**Notes** - Stores nothing in your save. You can remove it at any time. - Preview objects it detaches are discarded by the game anyway. A real decoration prop it detaches stays where it is as a standalone prop. - This works around the symptom; the underlying issue has been reported to Paradox.
Source code: https://github.com/Luffytse/cs2-ownercheck
